_note: Login spec for make-storage-state.mjs — SPX mobile WEB build. EMAIL login skips the image captcha but the universal code 123456 only validates AFTER a sendVerificationCode call, so we click 发送验证码 first. locale=zh-CN + seedLocalStorage spx.locale make extract-impl boot Chinese (Figma home 365:2388). spx-ui-test-bypass-pay=1 skips the pay-password gate so /(app) home renders instead of redirecting. NOTE: the HttpOnly unibit-token cookie is cross-site (localhost->staging-api) and is NOT persisted, so balances render in the empty/0.00 state locally. Secret via env: SPX_USER.
